newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle market at standstill -USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle market at standstill -USDA.

text.p: Trade was at a standstill in the Panhandle area early Monday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers not tested. Feedlots reporting good inquiry from buyers. Last established market was $68.00 per cwt on Friday.

Bids Monday were $67.00 to mostly $68.00, with asking prices $69.00-$70.00. There were 4,600 head confirmed for the week to date. Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
